in_sanskrit.name: सत्यनारायण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies truth and eternal wisdom, the supreme deity who protects and nurtures the universe.

in_hindi.name: सत्यनारायण
in_hindi.long_meaning: सत्य का देव (The god of truth) या नारायण (Narayana, the one who nurtures and protects)

in_tamil.name: சத்யநாராயண
in_tamil.long_meaning: சத்யம் பிறப்புக்குள்ள தேவம் (The god who embodies truth) அல்லது அல்லது நாராயணம் (Narayanam, the eternal one)

in_telugu.name: సత్యనారాయణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: సత్యమై యొజ్జేశ్యేదు (The one who embodies truth) అయ్యహ్ నారాయణయ్యదు (Narayanayyaadu, the eternal one)

in_marathi.name: Satyanarayana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Truth and Loyalty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyanarayana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who always speaks the truth and maintains loyalty to his word and deity.

in_bengali.name: Satyanarayana
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Truth and Loyalty
in_bengali.long_meaning: Satyanarayana একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who always speaks the truth and maintains loyalty to his word and deity.
